overview.en: The Beautiful Woodpecker is endemic to Colombia and is confined to the Magdalena River valley.
overview.fr: Le Pic splendide est endémique de Colombie et limité à la vallée du río Magdalena.

identification.en: The male has a red crown extending to the nape; the female has a black forecrown and red hindcrown, a pattern distinguishing it from the related Golden-naped Woodpecker (*M. chrysauchen*).
identification.fr: Chez le mâle, la calotte rouge s’étend jusqu’à la nuque ; chez la femelle, l’avant de la calotte est noir et l’arrière rouge, un motif qui le distingue du Pic à nuque dorée apparenté (*M. chrysauchen*).

habitat.en: It uses forest, forest fragments and, occasionally, plantations in the Magdalena valley.
habitat.fr: Dans la vallée du Magdalena, il fréquente les forêts, leurs fragments et parfois les plantations.

diet.en: It takes insects, including termites and beetles, and supplements them with fruits and seeds.
diet.fr: Il consomme des insectes, notamment des termites et des coléoptères, ainsi que des fruits et des graines.

behavior.en: It often forages in the middle or upper tree canopy, alone or in pairs, and calls from high branches.
behavior.fr: Il cherche souvent sa nourriture dans les étages moyens ou supérieurs des arbres, seul ou en couple, et chante depuis les hautes branches.

reproduction.en: Species-specific nesting details were not established by the regional sources consulted.
reproduction.fr: Les sources régionales consultées ne précisent pas les détails de sa nidification.

ecology.en: Its diet links tree-dwelling insects and fruits to the food web of Magdalena valley forests.
ecology.fr: Son régime, composé d’insectes arboricoles et de fruits, le relie au réseau trophique des forêts du Magdalena.

conservation.en: A 2024 Colombian endemic-bird atlas lists it as Least Concern nationally while documenting a restricted distribution and remaining forest cover.
conservation.fr: Un atlas colombien de 2024 classe l’espèce en préoccupation mineure à l’échelle nationale, tout en documentant une aire restreinte et un couvert forestier résiduel.

title.fr: Oiseaux de la réserve naturelle Riomanso — WCS Colombia

facts: The WCS guide places this endemic woodpecker only in the Magdalena valley, in forests, fragments and sometimes plantations.

title.en: Aves y ecosistemas de Boyacá — Corpoboyacá
title.fr: Oiseaux et écosystèmes de Boyacá — Corpoboyacá

facts: The Spanish regional guide reports termites, beetles and larvae plus Cecropia, figs, seeds and palm fruits; birds forage in mid and upper tree levels, alone or in pairs, and call from high branches. It explains tree cavity excavation by woodpeckers generally, so no species-level nesting claim is made.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: Taxonomic proposal: Split Melanerpes pulcher from M. chrysauchen — South American Classification Committee
title.fr: Proposition taxonomique : séparer Melanerpes pulcher de M. chrysauchen — South American Classification Committee

facts: The SACC proposal describes plumage differences from the Golden-naped Woodpecker: male red crown reaches the nape; female has black forecrown and red hindcrown.

uncertainties: The Colombian WCS and Boyacá guides are regional accounts; their local observations should not be generalized beyond the species' known range.
The consulted regional accounts do not give species-specific nesting details.
review_note: Concise profile based on Colombian institutional and conservation sources in Spanish; local diet observations are attributed to a Boyacá guide.
